name: Docker Compose Generator
description: Generate a Docker Compose configuration from service definitions, with ports, environment, volumes and dependencies.

hints.services: Fill in the fields: the image is required and ports and volumes use the host:container form.
hints.output: The output is configuration text; nothing connects to a daemon and no image is pulled.

faq.a: No, it only assembles the template. Run docker compose config before deploying.

faq.q: Are health checks and resource limits supported?
faq.a: Not yet; the first version focuses on ports, environment, volumes and dependencies.
